lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant UI as Task Workspace View
    participant Codex
    participant MCP as Task MCP API
    participant Store as Task Store
    participant Design as Formal Design Workspace

    User->>UI: Create or edit open task
    UI->>Store: Persist title description and design links
    Codex->>MCP: create_task or update_task with high-confidence design links
    MCP->>Store: Persist open task
    Codex->>MCP: finish_task with memo and changed files
    MCP->>Store: Mark finished and store AI completion payload
    MCP->>Design: Load linked design branches when task is read
    User->>UI: Confirm finished task
    UI->>Store: Mark confirmed
    Note over UI,Store: Optional future Confirm plus Commit can store a commit id without making confirmation depend on git
    Note over MCP,Store: Future finish_task may create linked QA focus or smoke entries when the QA model exists
